intro: Niger is one of the largest countries in West Africa, and about four-fifths of it is desert.

chapters.title: Desert and river
text: The Aïr Mountains and the Ténéré desert cover the north. The Niger River flows through the south-west past Niamey. Lake Chad lies in the far south-east, though it has shrunk.

chapters.title: Climate
text: It is one of the hottest countries in the world, and droughts are common.

keyTerms.meaning: A sandy desert region of the Sahara.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Niger's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
